title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 9: Keiko Nagamatsu
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．９ ～永松恵子～
overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 9: Nagamatsu Keiko is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Keiko Nagamatsu. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.
